test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the context of Indian Freedom Movement, which of the following years is correctly paired with the event that took place that year?

options.text: 1915 – Mahatma Gandhi returned from South Africa
1944 – The Cripps Mission was sent by the British government to India to obtain Indian cooperation for the British war efforts in the 2nd World War
1945 – The All India Congress Committee met in Bombay and ratified the 'Quit India' resolution

solution:
The correct answer is __**1915 – Mahatma Gandhi returned from South Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **After over 21 years of stay in South Africa, Gandhi returned to India on January 9, 1915, with his wife Kasturba.**
 
• He had been in London the previous year to treat a severe bout of pleurisy, a lung inflammation.
 
• His doctors advised him to return to India to escape the English winter.
 
• A hero's welcome awaited Gandhi when** he landed on January 9, 1915, at the Apollo Bunder in Bombay. **
 
• **On 4 February 1916, Gandhiji made his first public appearance after returning from South Africa to BHU. He addressed the audience in BHU.**
 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is a celebratory day observed on 9 January by the Republic of India to commemorate the return of Mahatma Gandhi from South Africa to Mumbai on 9 January 1915.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **1942 – The Cripps Mission** was sent by the British government to India to obtain Indian cooperation for the British war efforts in the 2nd World War.
 
• **1930 –** The first Round Table Conference convened from **12 November 1930 to 19 January 1931.**
 
• **1942 – **From 7 to 8 August 1942, The All India Congress Committee met in Bombay and ratified the 'Quit India' resolution.
